attchmntText: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited submitted copies of a newspaper advertisement dated November 14, 2026, to BSE Limited and NSE. The Board of Directors approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The advertisement was published in Financial Express and Jansatta. The results are also available on the company website at https://worldsolar.in/. The document contains extracts of financial results for other entities including Sharat Industries Limited, Annu Projects Limited, HandsOn Global Management Limited, Sarthak Metals Limited, Gulshan Polyols Limited, and Travel Food Services Limited, all reporting results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, received from Crisil Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer and Pre-IPO, totaling Rs 5,500.00 million. Crisil Ratings Limited reported no deviation in the utilization of funds towards the original objects. However, the company revised the object of the issue pursuant to shareholder approval obtained through a special resolution. The unutilized proceeds are proposed to be deployed towards the revised object in forthcoming quarters. The variation is attributed to this change in object approved by shareholders. The IPO was conducted between September 22, 2025, and September 25, 2025, with a gross issue size of Rs 4,400.00 million. The Pre-IPO allotment occurred on November 21, 2024, for Rs 1,100.00 million. The monitoring agency confirmed that all arrangements pertaining to technical assistance and collaboration are in operation.

attchmntText: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has made available the audio recording of the earnings call regarding the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 13, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. IST. The recording is accessible on the company website at https://worldsolar.in/earnings-call-audio-recording-q2-fy27/. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Press Release- Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited filed an intimation regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For Q2 FY27, total income was 2,549.0 million rupees, EBITDA was 151.5 million rupees, and PAT was 41.9 million rupees. For H1 FY27, total income reached 4,329.3 million rupees, EBITDA was 358.2 million rupees, and PAT was 136.9 million rupees. The Board approved a 50:50 joint venture with Rays Power Infra to establish a 2.4 GW solar PV cell manufacturing facility at Narmadapuram, Madhya Pradesh. The estimated project cost is approximately 1,000 crore rupees, with commercial production targeted for June 2027. The company commissioned a 50 MW AC solar project in Assam and received charging permission for the 200 MW AC and 272 MW DC Khavda project in Gujarat. Solarworld also launched residential and C&I BESS products and is exploring opportunities in the Data Centre EPC segment.

attchmntText: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 2439.7 million, up 1684.2 percent year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 41.9 million, down 55 percent year-on-year. The company secured orders worth Rs. 12,711 million from NTPC REL and NTPC UP Green Energy Limited. It launched BESS and C&I products at REI 2026. A joint venture for solar cell manufacturing targets commercial operations by June 2027. The 50 MW AC Assam project was commissioned. Charging permission was received for the 200 MW AC and 272 MW DC Khavda project. The order book stands at Rs. 38,569 million as of October 31, 2026.

attchmntText: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board reported a profit before tax of 64 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 13920 million for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The company received a favourable decision from the Dispute Adjudication Board regarding a suspended Engineering, Procurement and Construction project with SIVN Green Energy Limited, awarding an amount of Rs. 402.67 million. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report stating that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial results. The meeting commenced at 2:00 p.m. and concluded at 3:40 p.m. on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited has scheduled an earnings call with analysts and investors for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 05:30 PM IST. The call will discuss the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company filed this notice pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Participants can dial in using the provided numbers or pre-register via the Diamond Pass link. Key company participants include Mukut Goyal, the Chief Financial Officer, and Varsha Bharti, the Company Secretary. Kartik Teltia is listed as the Chairman. MUFG Intime India Private Limited representatives Mr. Nikunj Seth and Ms. Sakshi Mehta are also included in the contact list.
